principles: Do not duplicate active sibling-story UX ownership.
Opt-in automation cannot create or refresh authority-sensitive evidence.
Structured hashes/manifests are stronger than operator narration.
Canonical docs and JSON compatibility are part of the command contract.
drivers: B-6914 exposed a safe but costly done_prepare rerun loop caused by generated metadata commits rebinding HEAD.
B-eb08 already changes done_prepare closeout heartbeat/json behavior and will conflict if B-fbcf edits the same regions from stale main.
B-eb92 and B-b264 own adjacent done_prepare guidance semantics, so B-fbcf must layer automation on top rather than rewording their guidance.
Operators need a deterministic path that stages only current-run lifecycle metadata and refuses unrelated dirt.
Skipping validation is admissible only when material/story-owned files and validation policy inputs are mechanically unchanged.

options.name: A: implement B-fbcf directly on current main
cons: Risk of duplicating sibling UX work

options.name: B: wait for B-eb08/B-eb92/B-b264 all to merge before any B-fbcf DEV
cons: Blocks this story on multiple unfinished stories

options.name: C: plan now, then start B-fbcf DEV only after B-eb08 is merged or explicitly integrated; treat B-eb92/B-b264 as semantic boundaries unless they merge first
pros: Avoids the known code conflict while preserving progress
Lets tests assert non-duplication without depending on unfinished strings
cons: Requires a pre-DEV main sync/integration checkpoint

options.name: D: combine B-fbcf with B-eb08/B-eb92/B-b264 into one large done_prepare story
cons: Destroys ownership boundaries and creates a risky oversized gate story

chosen: C: plan now, then start B-fbcf DEV only after B-eb08 is merged or explicitly integrated; treat B-eb92/B-b264 as semantic boundaries unless they merge first
rationale: Choose C because B-eb08 already has a real done_prepare.ts/code-catalog/package diff, so B-fbcf implementation from stale main would be wasteful and risky. B-fbcf can still complete PLAN, canonicalize the doc, and define fail-closed contracts now. DEV must begin from a baseline that includes or deliberately integrates B-eb08; B-eb92/B-b264 remain non-overlap boundaries unless merged before B-fbcf reaches those code paths.

preMortem.trigger: Implementation edits done_prepare.ts from main without integrating story/B-eb08.
preMortem.consequence: Merge conflict or lost liveness behavior.
preMortem.mitigation: Before DEV code edits, merge main after B-eb08 DONE or explicitly integrate story/B-eb08 as a known dependency; keep auto-closeout code behind B-eb08-compatible json/liveness APIs.

preMortem.scenario: B-fbcf duplicates B-eb92 review assurance guidance.
preMortem.trigger: Auto-closeout blockers invent cannot-auto-sign or fallback wording.
preMortem.mitigation: Use canonical review-assurance status/guidance functions when available; otherwise only assert that B-fbcf does not auto-write review/fallback evidence.

preMortem.trigger: Auto-closeout refusal text starts explaining merge hazards or generic rerun deltas.
preMortem.consequence: Overlapping UX ownership and stale guidance.
preMortem.mitigation: Limit refusal text to auto-closeout safety refusal and defer merge/rerun explanation to B-b264 surfaces.

preMortem.scenario: Manifest classifier is too broad and stages user work.
preMortem.trigger: A dirty docs/source/runtime file appears under a path that looks lifecycle-adjacent.
preMortem.consequence: auto-closeout commits unrelated or unsafe changes.
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse lifecycle artifact classifier, require current-run producer records, re-read git status, refuse non-manifest dirt, and stage exact manifest paths only.

preMortem.scenario: Validation reuse accepts stale evidence after semantic drift.
preMortem.trigger: materialHash, storyFilesHash, commandSetHash, policy/config hash, scope contract hash, or DONE-required inputs changed.
preMortem.consequence: DONE prepare reports PASS without rerunning commands that should have been rerun.
preMortem.mitigation: Require every binding hash to match prior PASS evidence; otherwise refuse reuse and follow normal validation path.

preMortem.scenario: JSON output is polluted by human auto-closeout text.
preMortem.trigger: Progress or refusal strings are written to stdout in JSON mode.
preMortem.consequence: automation callers fail to parse done_prepare output.
preMortem.mitigation: Honor B-eb08 JSON contract and add parseability smoke tests.

preMortem.scenario: Auto-closeout starts acting like authority evidence.
preMortem.trigger: A helper writes review pass, host verdict, delivery check, fallback, receipt, release, or production readiness facts.
preMortem.consequence: The feature weakens DONE gates instead of reducing a metadata loop.
preMortem.mitigation: Add no such write calls, assert no authority-sensitive artifacts/events are created, and leave story_advance DONE manual.
